# Settlements

The **Settlements** page provides administrators with a centralized interface to **manage vendor settlement requests and approvals**. It enables authorized users to monitor pending settlement requests, review requested amounts, approve or reject requests, and access processed settlement requests.

#### Accessing the Settlement Page

The **Settlement** page can be accessed through the **Vendors** module from the left-side navigation panel. It provides administrators with access to vendor settlement requests, approvals, rejections, and processed settlement records.

#### Navigation Path

**Login → Vendors → Settlements**

{% stepper %}
{% step %}
### Log in to CorpCash

Sign in to the CorpCash application using valid administrator credentials.

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image.png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Access the Main Dashboard

After successful authentication, the CorpCash dashboard is displayed.

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (23).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Locate Vendors

From the left-side navigation panel, locate the **Vendors** module. Click the **Vendors** menu or expand icon to display its available options.&#x20;

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (24).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Locate Settlements

Under the Vendors menu, locate the **Settlements** option. Click **Settlements**.

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (26).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Open Settlement Dashboard

The system navigates to the **Settlements** page.

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (27).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}
{% endstepper %}
